name: EQT
outlook:
What EQT says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: volume, capex and wellsThe Company expects total sales volume of 550 – 600 Bcfe in the fourth quarter of 2026, which includes the impact of 10 – 20 Bcfe of strategic curtailments. The Company expects $540 – $610 million of maintenance capital expenditures in the fourth quarter of 2026. Strategic growth capital expenditures in the fourth quarter of 2026 are expected to total $185 – $225 million. The Company plans to turn-in-line (TIL) 16 – 26 net wells in the fourth quarter of 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
